name: SpecCloud
description: FFT spectral band clouds. Input is split into logarithmic bands whose gains are randomly re-rolled. X = band count, Y = re-roll probability / smoothing. Touch instantly redraws the cloud.

params.name: FLUX
params.detail: Per-hop chance a band gain is redrawn

params.name: SMOOTH
params.detail: How slowly band gains glide after a roll
